title: The Supreme Band under Pete Lacasse, Eddie Jackson managing
summary: Russ joined the Supreme Band with Lacasse as leader and Eddie Jackson as manager, around 1925-26, later playing the Royal Garden on Gravier Street.

The Supreme Band. They was a band in about two years or two and a half years. I joined, I rejoined in Louisiana, jazz town again. I was playing at the Royal Garden on Graber Street. Must have been around about twenty-six. Stay with that band two years. The people of Cass and them come back and they heard me play with the Blue-Kanami jazz town at the Royal Garden.
